ENGINEERING · EVERYDAY CHINESE

为什么上坡要换挡？

Why change gears uphill?

Up to 400 characters. The built-in pronunciation profile is based on Taiwan Mandarin; listen for regional differences.

Prepare the voice to begin.

Save audio
English translation of the article

When cycling uphill, you can shift to a lower gear. Pedalling feels easier, but each turn moves the bicycle a shorter distance. A lower gear does not create energy: it trades speed for greater turning force. A car's gearbox uses a similar principle. Next time you ride uphill in a car, listen for changes in the engine sound.
